assembly_info.comments:
The annotation was added by the NCBI Prokaryotic Genome Annotation Pipeline (PGAP). Information about PGAP can be found here: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genome/annotation_prok/
This is the sequence of the main genome of the GT-S strain, which diverged from the Omata's strain, a derivative of the Williams' GT (glucose-tolerant) strain. Kazusa strain was also a sub-strain of the Omata's strain.
All annotations are essentially based on the annotation on the Kazusa strain BA000022, but the N-terminus of some proteins were edited to fit to close homologs of other cyanobacteria.
